messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-04-22, the search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- On 2026-04-14, the Dune team observed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- As of 2025-12-05, the pager for the reporting service rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
- The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by Cinder as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- The reports pipeline must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands. [constraint; valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]
- As of 2025-12-05, the reporting service is owned by the Ember team, having transferred from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
    earlier: The reporting service is a Dune team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-12-05; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- On 2026-06-04, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team observed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team, when ownership passed from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes. [constraint; valid 2025-01-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-31]
- Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle as of 2025-07-30. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz has the Atlas pager this cycle as of 2025-06-19. [valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle as of 2025-05-13. [valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Tomasz has the Atlas pager this cycle as of 2025-04-03, replacing Priya Raman. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Priya Raman still has the Atlas pager as of 2025-03-28. [valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-28]
- As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team; ownership transferred from the Ember team on that date, and the Dune team never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Dune team; ownership transferred from the Ember team on that date. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-06, the feature-flags service is owned by the Ember team; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11; recorded by handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of the 2025-12-19 handover, the product catalog's dashboards and alerts are being repointed. [valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
